Callout.Name: Missing Child
Callout.Message: Child reported missing from a shopping centre.
Callout.Advisory: Seven years old, last seen ten minutes ago, mother with staff.

Script.Line: He was with me on the escalator and then he was not.
Two minutes. I looked down at my phone for two minutes.
He is seven. He has a red jacket on. That is all I can tell you.

Lines.Approach: Seven years old and missing ten minutes in a shopping centre. Staff are checking cameras now.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
